theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_lhr_cub_scalar_c1_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (U K : Set (Rn n)) (f : Rn n → ℝ), 0 < α → α ≤ 1 → IsOpen U → IsCompact K → Convex ℝ K → K ⊆ U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f U → ∃ S : ℝ, 0 ≤ S ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, |f x| ≤ S ∧ |f x - f y| ≤ S * ‖x - y‖ ^ α
